newsitem.title: USA: Medi-Ject Q4 feels impact of R&D spending.
newsitem.headline: Medi-Ject Q4 feels impact of R&D spending.

text.p: Medi-Ject Corp said its losses for the fourth quarter and full year reflect the company's research and development spending.

"The recent granting by the U.S. Patent Office of a patent for a new gas spring injector energy source reflects progress the company is making to improve needle-free delivery systems," noted chairman Franklin Pass in a statement.
Medi-Ject attributed its higher revenues to an agreement with Becton Dickinson and Co and other development and licensing partners.
In the most recent quarter, Pass said revenues also reflect significant, nonrecurring shipments of its products for growth hormone administration and for use in clinical trials.
The company reported a fourth-quarter loss of $0.07 per share on total revenues of $1.2 million.
